tests: Cost dominated by huge retrieved-context input tokens (60k-100k/call) where the static LOW-tier token estimate massively underestimates per-call input cost.
why_low_tier_will_miss: The LOW-tier static estimate uses turnDefaults (system 800 + user 120 + tool_overhead + tool_result 500 ~ a few thousand input tokens, not 80k) at the default 100 calls/day, so it will project roughly an order of magnitude too low; convergence requires the forecaster to read this agent's true 80k-token retrieved context and 200 calls/day to approach the ~$714/mo truth.
